$schema: ANA-01 per-field analytics comparator manifest schema skeleton
purpose: Defines the exact comparison categories and default numeric tolerances. ANA-01 owns adding fixture-backed per-field entries; fields may not fall back to an unlisted global tolerance.

exact.rule: Values in this category must compare exactly.

canonical-rounded.rule: Integer seconds and canonically rounded display values are exact after applying the same rounding rule.

float-primitive.rule: Floating primitives start with an absolute tolerance.

normalized-score.rule: Normalized scores and ordinary scalar pipelines start with an absolute tolerance.

spectral-iterative.rule: Spectral and iterative outputs start with a relative tolerance and an absolute floor.

wider_tolerance_requirements.rule: A field may use a wider tolerance only when all requirements are recorded; otherwise its category default applies.

real_capture_supplement.rule: Real-capture plausibility ranges supplement but never replace Dart/Swift parity.
